title: AgentStatus
description: Heartbeat and status report published by a Site Agent.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent instance.

status.description: Current operational status of this agent.

degradation_level.description: Current degradation level at this site.

speed_factor.description: Current robot speed multiplier (1.0 = full speed, 0.0 = stopped).

connected_to_brain.description: Whether this agent is connected to the NetworkBrain.

pending_override_requests.description: Number of actions awaiting human approval.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp of this status report.
